annotations.text:
Apps screen — Xteink X3, 528×792 portrait, 1-bit e-ink.
Matched to the firmware: Inter Medium/Bold at 10/12pt, 45px header, 60px content top, 40px hint bar, 12px gutter.
TODAY — drawTileCover: solid black fill, white inset frame, centred label. Eight identical black slabs; the name is the only thing telling them apart, and the selected tile is black-on-black.

A — Icon grid. Squares at 3-up (160×160), 56px stroke icon over a 13px name. Reads as a launcher at a glance. Selection inverts the whole card, so it stays obvious on e-ink.
Cost: MIN_CELL_WIDTH 200 → 160, and eight new icons to draw.

B — Wide card. Keeps today's exact geometry (2-up, 246×135) and changes only the tile interior: 46px icon left, name right.
Cheapest to ship — no layout constants change — and long labels stop shrinking the font.

Six candidates for Games. B (Blocks) and F (Maze) hold up best at 1-bit — every stroke is horizontal or vertical, so nothing softens when the tile inverts. C (Die) is the most instantly readable but its filled dots read close to Tasbih's beads two tiles away.

Both directions need new icons. The UIIcon enum has Folder, Text, Image, Book, File, Recent, Settings, Transfer, Library, Wifi, Hotspot, Bookmark, Stats, Apps — nothing for Games, Tasbih, Stop Watch, Pomodoro, Gym, Quran or BLE. The ones drawn here are stroke-based on a 24px grid so they scale and invert cleanly; they would need converting to the firmware's icon format.

The first puzzle path was malformed - lopsided tabs, arcs joined at inconsistent points, bounding box off-centre. Rebuilt from geometry: 16px square, r=2.6 semicircular knobs at each edge midpoint, silhouette centred on (12,12).

The left edge was also clipping: its arc carried sweep=1, which runs bottom-left-top and pushes the curve out to x=0.1 (x=-0.7 once the 1.6 stroke is counted), past the viewBox. It needed sweep=0 - bottom-right-top - which is the socket that was intended. P1 is now in both direction artboards.
